# Three.js

`three.module.js` and `three.core.js` are the unmodified ES modules from Three.js r180 (npm package `three@0.180.0`). The upstream distribution is https://www.npmjs.com/package/three/v/0.180.0 and source is https://github.com/mrdoob/three/tree/r180.

Both modules retain their upstream copyright/license headers. The full MIT license is in `three.LICENSE`. The Home scene imports only the local modules; no CDN or runtime package lookup is needed.
